```{r}
td <- tribble(
  ~day,       ~condition, ~starttime,              ~stoptime,
  "Monday",   "movie",    "03/06/2019 19:37:00",   "03/06/2019 21:37:00",
  "Tuesday",  "movie",    "04/06/2019 20:32:22",   "04/06/2019 22:32:22",
  "Wednesday","movie",    "05/06/2019 20:35:18",   "05/06/2019 22:35:18",
  "Thursday", "movie",    "06/06/2019 19:42:01",   "06/06/2019 21:42:01",
  "Monday",   "book",     "10/06/2019 17:51:04",   "10/06/2019 19:51:04",
  "Tuesday",  "book",     "11/06/2019 17:33:30",   "11/06/2019 19:33:30"
)

# Parse datetimes and convert to Unix timestamps
td <- td %>%
  mutate(
    starttime = dmy_hms(starttime) %>% as.numeric(),
    stoptime  = dmy_hms(stoptime)  %>% as.numeric(),
  )

td_processed <- td_processed %>% select(-starttime, -stoptime) %>% left_join(td, by = c('condition', 'day'))

td_processed <- td_processed %>% mutate(trecon = '0') %>% rename('stim' = 'Date')
```


```{r}
merged_data <- new_merger(processed_emotibit = physio, td = td_processed %>% setDT(), hour_adjust = 1, condcols = c('condition', 'stim'))

HR_syn <- crqa_full(data = merged_data, analyses = c('HR'), condcols = 'condition', pinfo = 'stim', delay = 12, embed = 2, rescale = 1, radius = 0.6,
    normalize = 1, mindiagline = 10, minvertline = 10,
    tw = 0, whiteline = FALSE, recpt = FALSE, side = "both",
    threshold = 3, datatype = "numerical")

saveout_datalist(HR_syn)
```

```{r}
new_merger <- function (processed_emotibit = NULL, processed_gorilla = NULL, 
  td = NULL, sinfo = NULL, pd = NULL, sd = NULL, ed = NULL, 
  condcols = c("category", "condition", "item", "stim"), normlevel = 1, 
  pinfo = NULL, gd = NULL, baseline = FALSE, hour_adjust = 0, 
  stop_at_plotcheck = F, eda_check = list(mean = 20, range_min = 0.01, 
    low = 0.03, high = 25)) 
{
  if (!is.null(processed_emotibit)) {
    ed <- processed_emotibit$ed
    sinfo <- processed_emotibit$sinfo
  }
  if (!is.null(processed_gorilla)) {
    td <- copy(processed_gorilla$td)
    pd <- processed_gorilla$pd
    sd <- processed_gorilla$sd
  }
  ed$t <- ed$utc + hour_adjust * 3600 # if summer time
  sinfo$utc_start <- sinfo$utc_start + hour_adjust * 3600
  sinfo$utc_end <- sinfo$utc_end + hour_adjust * 3600
  
  dinfo <- c("pid", condcols)
  if ("start_time" %in% colnames(td)) {
    setnames(td, old = "start_time", new = "starttime")
  }
  if ("stop_time" %in% colnames(td)) {
    setnames(td, old = "stop_time", new = "stoptime")
  }
  if (!"starttime" %in% colnames(td) | !"stoptime" %in% colnames(td)) {
    return(cat("\nYou haven't got starttime and stoptime\n\n"))
  }
  if (!is.null(sinfo)) {
    sinfo[, `:=`(day, strftime(time_start, format = "%m-%d")), 
      by = time_start]
    td[, `:=`(day, strftime(as.POSIXct(starttime, origin = "1970-01-01", 
      tz = "Europe/London"), format = "%m-%d"))]
    pdb <- td[, .(exp_begin = min(starttime), exp_end = max(stoptime)), 
      by = .(pid, eid, day)]
    sessiondata <- ggplot(pdb, aes(x = exp_begin, xend = exp_end, 
      y = eid, yend = eid, label = pid)) + geom_segment(linewidth = 4, 
      alpha = 1) + geom_text(size = 2, nudge_y = 0.5) + 
      geom_segment(data = sinfo[filter == 1], inherit.aes = F, 
        linewidth = 1.5, aes(y = eid, yend = eid, x = utc_start, 
          xend = utc_end, colour = as.factor(trecon))) + 
      facet_wrap(day ~ ., scales = "free_x") + theme_bw() + 
      theme(legend.position = "none")
    if (stop_at_plotcheck) {
      return(sessiondata)
    }
    else {
      print(sessiondata)
    }
  }
  setkey(ed, t)
  td <- data.frame(td)
  if (length(dinfo) > 1) {
    td$tid <- apply(td[, dinfo], 1, paste, collapse = "-")
  }
  else {
    td$tid <- td[, dinfo]
  }
  if (normlevel == 1) {
    td$nid <- td[, dinfo[1]]
  }
  else {
    td$nid <- apply(td[, dinfo[1:normlevel]], 1, paste, 
      collapse = "-")
  }
  td <- data.table(td)
  grpn <- uniqueN(td$tid)
  pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = grpn, style = 3)
  emptrial <- td[, {
    setTxtProgressBar(pb, .GRP)
    ed[eid == .SD$eid & utc >= .SD$starttime & utc <= .SD$stoptime]
  }, by = .(tid, nid)]
  close(pb)
  ed <- copy(pid_merge(emptrial, td[!duplicated(tid), .SD, 
    .SDcols = c("tid", dinfo, pinfo)], link = "tid"))
  setnames(ed, "V1", "raw")
  ed[, `:=`(tt, as.numeric(t - min(t), units = "secs")), by = .(tid)]
  if (!is.null(eda_check) & "EA" %in% unique(ed$dv)) {
    pde <- ed[dv == "EA", .(mean = mean(raw, na.rm = T), 
      range = max(raw, na.rm = T) - min(raw, na.mr = T), 
      filter = 1), by = .(pid, eid)]
    pde[mean > eda_check$mean | range < eda_check$range_min, 
      `:=`(filter, 0)]
    if (dim(pde[filter == 0])[1] > 0) {
      cat("\nHere are people excluded because of high mean eda or low range:\n")
      pde[filter == 0]
    }
    ed[dv == "EA" & pid %in% pde[filter == 0]$pid, `:=`(filter, 
      0)]
    ed[dv == "EA" & (raw > eda_check$high | raw < eda_check$low), 
      `:=`(filter, 0)]
  }
  if (baseline == FALSE) {
    ed[filter == 1, `:=`(norm, scale(raw)), by = .(nid, 
      dv)]
  }
  else {
    stop("I haven't implemented norming by baselines yet")
  }
  ed[, `:=`(ttsec, floor(tt))]
  dm <- rbind(ed[filter == 1, .(metric = "raw", y = mean(raw, 
    na.rm = T)), by = c(condcols, "dv", "ttsec")], ed[filter == 
    1, .(metric = "norm", y = mean(norm, na.rm = T)), by = c(condcols, 
    "dv", "ttsec")])
  setnames(dm, c("ttsec", "dv"), c("t", "edv"))
  ess <- rbind(ed[filter == 1, .(x = "raw", mean = mean(raw, 
    na.rm = T), sd = sd(raw, na.rm = T), min = min(raw, 
    na.rm = T), max = max(raw, na.rm = T), range = max(raw, 
    na.rm = T) - min(raw, na.rm = T)), by = .(tid, dv)], 
    ed[filter == 1, .(x = "norm", mean = mean(norm, na.rm = T), 
      sd = sd(norm, na.rm = T), min = min(norm, na.rm = T), 
      max = max(norm, na.rm = T), range = max(norm, na.rm = T) - 
        min(norm, na.rm = T)), by = .(tid, dv)])
  evars <- c("mean", "sd", "min", "max", "range")
  td <- pid_merge(td, dcast(ess, tid ~ x + dv, value.var = evars), 
    link = "tid")
  td <- pid_merge(td, dcast(ed[, .(filterprop = mean(filter)), 
    by = .(tid, dv)], tid ~ dv, value.var = "filterprop", 
    ), link = "tid")
  filter_vars <- paste0("filter_prop_", unique(ed$dv))
  setnames(td, old = unique(ed$dv), new = filter_vars)
  item_vars <- c(grep(x = colnames(td[, .SD, .SDcols = is.numeric]), 
    pattern = "raw_", value = T), grep(x = colnames(td[, 
    .SD, .SDcols = is.numeric]), pattern = "norm_", value = T))
  item_means <- td[, lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = T), .SDcols = item_vars, 
    by = setdiff(dinfo, c("pid", pinfo))]
  if (is.null(sd)) {
    sd <- item_means
  }
  else {
    sd <- pid_merge(sd, item_means, link = setdiff(dinfo, 
      c("pid", pinfo)))
  }
  pd_vars <- c(grep(x = item_vars, pattern = "mean_raw", value = T), 
    grep(x = item_vars, pattern = "range_raw", value = T), 
    filter_vars)
  pd_means <- td[, lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = T), .SDcols = pd_vars, 
    by = pid]
  if (is.null(pd)) {
    pd <- pd_means
  }
  else {
    pd <- pid_merge(pd, pd_means)
  }
  if (!is.null(eda_check) & "EA" %in% unique(ed$dv)) {
    edaplot <- mypirate(ed[dv == "EA"], dv = "raw", x_condition = "eid", 
      colour_condition = "pid", legend = F, title = "EDA for each subject, split by sensor", 
      dots = F) + geom_point(data = td, inherit.aes = F, 
      aes(y = mean_raw_EA, x = eid, colour = pid)) + geom_hline(aes(yintercept = eda_check$mean)) + 
      geom_label(data = td[, .(fpp = sprintf("%1.1f%%", 
        100 * mean(filter_prop_EA))), by = .(pid, eid)], 
        inherit.aes = F, aes(x = eid, colour = pid, 
          label = fpp, y = mean(td$mean_raw_EA, na.rm = T)))
    print(edaplot)
  }
  return(list(ed = ed, dm = dm, td = td, pd = pd, sd = sd))
}
```
